title: Particle-preserving fermionic shadows with mode-independent sample complexity
summary: We consider the problem of learning expectation values of particle-preserving operators with respect to an unknown $η$-particle $n$-mode fermionic state via classical shadows. Our main application is to estimating overlaps with arbitrary Slater determinant states: While it is known that such overlaps can, in the average case, be learnt to a fixed additive precision with a constant number of samples, the best-known worst case bound is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt n \log n)$; here we improve this to $\mathcal{O}(η\logη)$, achieving a mode-independent sample cost.
